name: 全頁慣性捲動
desc: 整頁捲動帶有緩衝與滑行感，手機版改用系統原生捲動。
prompt: 整個頁面使用慣性捲動：捲動時畫面帶有緩衝，停手後會再滑行一小段才停下。
mobile: 手機版使用系統原生的捲動。

en.name: Full-page smooth inertial scrolling
en.desc: Scrolling across the whole page is cushioned and glides on; mobile uses the system's native scrolling.
en.prompt: Across the whole page, use smooth inertial scrolling: scrolling is cushioned, and after the user stops, the page glides a little further before coming to rest.
en.mobile: On mobile, use the system's native scrolling.
